book.title: N'halo ghwa maha handa paghutyekwite na MALIKI

content: Lukilu lwa kunkoma Yesu

Yikibha masiku mabhili yikali na kuyingiha chekwa ya Pasaka na ya mangate ya nga kuyingihwa linjacha. Akaandundame akulu na ahunda bha malaghilo bhakipalaha njila ya kunkamula Yesu kwa njenjelo ngati bhankome.
Mana bhakighomba, “Tukotoo kunkamula lisiku lya chekwa ya Pasaka, kiyaha bhandu bhaatenda bhulwa.”
Yesu kangunpopokehehwa mahuta ku Betania

Yesu pakabheghite akwo ku Betania kulubhagha lwa Simoni ywakabheghite na maloha, pakabheghite mukindangabhala pakalyegha hilyo kakihika nndala yumo ywakabheghite na kyupa kya liganga lya alabasita kina mahuta ghanakunungila munu gha ngalabha ngulu, kakakimetula kila kyupa na kakinpopohela Yesu mumutwe ghwake
Bhandu amoo bhangi bhaabheghite pala bhakighombana bhene kwa mabhene, “Kiyaha niki mahuta aghangalabha ngulu ghangunyanyanganwa hela?
Mahuta agha ghangahemelitwe kwa ngalabha ngulu na ngalabha ahyo bhangabhapeghite kapukwa.” Bhakinlakalila munu yula nndala.
Peni Yesu kakiaghombela, “Bhuli mungunng'aha? Munneke, kiyaha kanndendela nnando ghunakuhalala.
Makapukwa mmegha nabho masiku ghoha na mahotola kubhatanga masiku ghoheli ghamughapalite. Peni nenga kahone kubhegha papamu masiku ghoha.
Nndala ayu kandendela kila kakahotolite, kalongolela kuntyelemeka mahuta mmili ghwangu kyakummika kala kya kungulila.
Kulyaghila nenga nungubhaghombela pohele pala pannima payilandamihwa Nhalo ghwa Maha, nnando aghu ghwakatendite nndala ayu ghwakambukwa kwa uhwacho ghwake.”
Yuda kanguyitikila kunkiluka Yesu
Ndo Yuda Isikaliyote yumoo ywa bhala ahundwa mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili kakighenda kwa andundame akulu ngati kakankiluke Yesu.
Mandundame akulu pakayihwite nhalo aghwo bhakiyelelwa munu, bhakinnagha kunpegha ngalabha. Hinu Yuda kakiyanda kupalaha ling'ebu lya kunkiluka Yesu.
Yesu kangulyegha hilyo ya Pasaka papamu na Ahundwa bhake
Lisiku lya ulongohi lya chekwa ya mangate ya nga kuyingihwa linjacha, lisiku paanhinjite mwana mene ahundwa bhake bhakinkonya Yesu, “Ghungupala tughutendekehele kwoki pakulyegha Pasaka?”
Hinu Yesu kakialaghila abhili muahundwa bhake, kakiaghombela, “Nng'ende kukitami, na akwo ma mmona nnume yumo yunakuyegha kibhigha kya machi ndo muntughile,

mbaka ku lubhagha lwakayingila munng'ombele yula nkola kaya pakayingiliti yula yuna kibhigha ‘Nhunda kangukonya, kyumba kati kyake kibhegha kwoki kya agheni kyene kikapala kulyegha Pasaka papamu na ahundwa bhangu?’
Naywo katabhalaha chumba kati kikulu muligholofa lyake na maabhona hilibhi hyoha hibhegha kala kwa kya twenga.”
Bhala ahundwa bhakibhuka, bhakighenda kukitami, na bhakibhona hilibhi hyoha tela tela handa Yesu pakaaghombilite na bhakitendekeha hilyo hya Pasaka amwo.
Payihikite makimuhi, Yesu kakihika papamu na ahundwa bhake mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili.
Paabheghite mukulyegha hilyo Yesu kakiaghombela, “Kulyaghila nungubhaghombela yumoo ywenu yunakulyegha papamu na nenga katangiluka.”
Apa ahundwa bhake bhakiyanda kuhyononeka, bhakinkonya yumu mbole ya yumu “Ngati nenga ng'obhe?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Ndi yumoo ywenu mwenga mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili, yuna kuchwika lingate papamu na nenga mukipumbulu.
Kiyaha Mwana ghwa Mundu katakomwa handa yityekitwe. Peni kimmone Mundu yula ywakankiluka mwana ghwa Mundu mbaha mundu aywo kangalepelitwe kubhelekwa!”
Mulyo ghwa Bambo
Paabheghite mukulyegha Yesu kakitola lingate, kakilumba, kakilimetula na kuapegha ahundwa bhake pakighomba. “Mughutole nlyeghe aghu ndo mmili ghwangu.”
Mbole kakitola nteko ghwa difwai, Kakinnumba Chapanga na kakibhapegha bhoha bhakinyweghela nteko aghwo.
Kakiaghombela, “Aghu ndo mwahi ghwangu ghwa Ninganilo, ghuuchecheka kwa kya bhandu bha ayaloho.
Kulyaghila ningubhaghombela, nda nywegha kangi ng'obhe difwai ya lisabibu mbaka lisiku lila linonda kunywegha ya hyono mu Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga.”
Paayimbite kala nhambo, bhakibhuka bhakighenda kukitumbi kya Miseituni.
Yesu kangulondola kukita Petili katankana
Yesu kakibhaghombela ahundwa bhake, “Mabhoha mwenga mataneka, Mana matyeko ghaghomba, ‘Ndantuta yunakuhakila, na mene nabho bhatapwilinganika.’
Peni mbole ya kuhyuka, ndabhalongolela kula ku Galilaya.”
Petili kakighombela Yesu, “Hata handa bhoha bhataghuleka, nenga ndaghuleka ng'obhe.”
Yesu kakinng'ombela Petili, “Kulyaghila ningughughombela uhiku aghu ghwanganila pandatu, ukakali na kubhika njogholo pabhili.”
Peni Petili kakighendelela kughomba, “Hata payinoghela kuhwegha papamu na ghwenga, ndaghuleka ng'obhe.” Nabho ahundwa bhangi bhoha bhakighomba bhu bhwabhu abho.
Yesu kanguyupa pakitogholo kya Getisamene
Bhakihika mukitogholo kya Getisemani, Yesu kakibhaghombela ahundwa bhake, “Ntame apa, nenga pang'enda kuyupa.
Mbole kakibhatola Petili na Yakobu na Yohana. Naywo Yesu kakiyanda kuhyononeka na kughayaghaya.”
Kakibhaghombela, “Mwoyo ghwangu ghubha na luhyononeko ugheghela na kuhwegha. Ntami apa na nkilukihe.”
Kakighenda ulongolo pamandina, kakighwegha pahi makukama, kakiyupa kukita, handa yahotoleka kuyingila lisaa alyo lya kimbamanda linhyetuke.
Kakighomba, “Tate ghwangu, kwa ghwenga mihalo hyoha yinguhotoleka. Ghumuhile nteko aghu peni yikotoke kubhegha kimbala nenga ngati kila ghukipalite ghwenga.”
Kakibhuya kwa ahundwa bhake bhala andatu kakibhabhona akighonja, kakinkonya Petili, “Simoni, ghukighonja? Ghulepelwa kukiluha hata lisaa limu?
Nkiluhe na kuyupa mangayingila mumayigho. Nhuki ghungupala peni mmili ghubhegha nnelebhu.”
Kakighenda kangi kuyupa pakighomba malagho ghaghalaghala.
Mbole kakibhuya kwa ahundwa bhake, kakibhabhona akighonja kangi kiyaha mehu ghabhe ghakitopelwa na ng'ono nabho bhakimanya ng'obhe kya kunng'ombela.
Kakibhabhuyila pandatu, na kakiakonya, “Nkali makaghonja na kupumulila? Hinu muyimuke, Lisaa lihika kala Mwana ghwa Mundu kangukamuhwa mumabhoko gha bhandu bhana ulemwa.
Nnyumuke tughende! Nnole, yula ywakunngiluka kaheghelela.”
Yesu kangukamulwa

Yesu pakabheghite akali mukughomba, Yuda, yumoo ywa bhala ahundwa mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili, kakihika papamu na lumati lwa bhandu bhaabheghite na mikechelo na hinduku. Bhandu abho bhakilaghilwa na andundame akulu ahunda bha malaghilo na aghohi.
Yuda Isikaliyote nkiluka kakibhapegha naho bhala bhandu kukita, “Yula yunonda kunhyubhatila, ndo mwene, munkamule na munng'eghe kindakila.”
Hino Yuda pakahikite, kakinng'endela Yesu na kaking'ombela “Nhunda!” Mbole kakinhyubhatila.
Bhala bhandu bhakinkamula Yesu, na bhakinbhika kindakila.
Ndo yumoo ywa bhala bhaayimite apo papamu na Yesu kakihomola kikechelo kyake kakintuta ndumitumi ghwa Ndundame Nkulu na kakinkechula likutu.
Yesu kakiakonya, “Nhika na mikechelo na hinduku handa kukita nenga ndi npoka?
Masiku ghoha nikibhegha papamu na mwenga panibhahunda mu Kitutubhi kya Chapanga, kya nga kungamula. Peni hino Matyeko ghanakung'anyima mbaka ghakamale.”
Ndo ahundwa bhake bhoha bhakinneka na kutukumbuka lubhilo.
Kakibha na nhongolo yumu ywakabheghite kanguntughila Yesu kakihwala nng'ololi nhuhu, nabho bhakiyigha kunkamula.
Peni mwene kakityelembuka kakighuleka ghula nnghololi kakitugha kyanga lipinda.
Yesu kuulongolo ghwa bhandu bha Libalasa likulu
Bhakinnyegha Yesu kwa Ndundame Nkulu nabho andundame akulu, aghohi na ahunda bha malaghilo bhakikongongana papamu.
Petili kakintughila Yesu kya kutalii, mbaka kulubhigho lwa Ndundame Nkulu. Akwo kakitama papamu na amachonda bha kupingikiha paakiyota mwoto.
Mandundame akulu na bhandu bhoha bha libalasa likulu bhakipalaha uyimiho ghwa kunkokeha Yesu ngati ankome, peni bhakilepelwa.
Bhandu ayoloho bhakighomba uyimiho ghwa uhwangi kwa kya Yesu, peni uyimiho ghwabhe ghukiponingana.
Ndo bhangi bhakiyima bhakilongela uyimiho ghwa uhwangi kwa kya ywombe pakilongela,
“Tukinnyihwa mundu ayu pakalongela, ‘Ndakihalulanga kitutubhi lya Chapanga ali liichengitwe na bhandu na mumasiku mandatu ndalichenga lingi lya nga kuchengwa kwa mabhoko gha anabhandu’”
Peni hata habhu unyimiho ghwabe ghukiponingana.
Ndundame Nkulu kakiyima nga paulongolo ghwabhe, kakinkonya Yesu, “Bhuli ghwenga ghuyanga ng'obhe? Ulemwa niki ghwaaghughombela?”
Peni ywombe kakinyamala jii na kakighomba ng'obhe hata lilagho limo. Ndundame Nkulu kakinkonya kangi, “Ghwenga ndo Kilisto, Mwana ghwa Chapanga Nkwiho?”
Yesu kakiyanga. “Ena nenga ndo mwene, kangi matammona Mwana ghwa Mundu katama mukibhoko kya nnilo kya Chapanga yunamakakala, pakahika mumahundi gha kuluhingu.”
Ndundame Nkulu kakilikachula lipinda lyake pakilongela; “Tughupalaha uyimiho ghwoki kangi?
Mwenga munyihwa pakanlighite Chapanga npimaki?” Bhoha bhakilamula kukita yinnoghela kakomwe.
Amoo bhangi bhakiyanda kunhunila mata, bhakinngubika mehu ghake na bhakintuta na kung'ombela “Ghulondole kukita ghani ywakakutulite!” Amachonda bhakintola na bhakintuta mambande.
Petili kangunkana Yesu
Petili pakabheghiteghe pahi kulubhigho, yumoo ywa akaandumitumi nndala ghwa Ndundame Nkulu kakihika.
Paka mmonite Petili pakayota mwoto, kakinnolekeha kaking'ombela, “Hata ghwenga ghukibha papamu na Yesu ghwa ku Nasaleti.”
Peni Petili kakimaka pakighomba, “Nummanya ng'obhe hangi ghughaghomba nigughamanya ng'obhe.” Mbole kakibhuka kakighenda pakuyingilila. Apa njogholo kakibhika.
Yula nndumitumi nndala pakammonite kangi Petili, kakiaghombela bhala ayimite nabho, “Mundu ayu ndi yumoo ywabhe.”
Petili kakimaka kangi. Mbole pamandina bhandu bha ayimite apwo bhakinng'ombela Petili, “Kulyaghila ghwenga ndi yumoo ywabhe, mana ghwenga ndi Nngalilaya.”
Peni Petili kakiyanda kukotola na kulapa pakighomba, “Nenga nunmanya ng'obhe mundu aywo yumunnghomba mihalu yake.”
Apa njogholo kakibhika paabhili, Petili kakihwachila kya aghombite Yesu “Ikali na njogholo kubhika paubhili ghwa nnganila pandatu” Petili kakilila munu kakipopoheka mahohi.
